item:Fish1.name: Goldfish
item:Fish1.description: It's not a snack, and it certainly doesn't smile back... for copyright reasons!

item:Fish2.name: Hermit_Can
item:Fish2.description: The branding on the soda can must have gotten washed off by some kind of liquidy, wavey substance. Oh, right.

item:Fish3.name: Jellyfish
item:Fish3.description: Don't let it sting you, unless you're into getting tinkled on by random beach-goers.

item:Fish4.name: Bloach
item:Fish4.description: The result of putting Blood and Leech into a bad pokemon generator.

item:Fish5.name: Skelefish
item:Fish5.description: Wow! Tapping on it's ribs really does make a xylophone noise!

item:Fish6.name: Sand_Shark
item:Fish6.description: It's not actually made of sand, not even in this universe.

item:Fish7.name: Manta_Ray
item:Fish7.description: Watch out for that stinger! It's called a 'stinger', but it will leave more of a deathy feeling than a stinging one.

item:Fish8.name: Kraken
item:Fish8.description: The tentacles writhe around as it plots it's next move toward bringing an end to this plane of existence.

item:Fish9.name: Icefish
item:Fish9.description: Scaled and icy, this coldblooded predator often travels out of the briney Seasalt shores to the Deepwater Docks to prey on Sand Sharks...

item:Fish10.name: Shellfish
item:Fish10.description: This gooey creature evolved from a common ancestor of the Dedotated Ram, hence the curled shell horns.

item:Fish11.name: Jumbo_Shrimp
item:Fish11.description: Woah momma thats a big shrimp...

item:Fish12.name: Caulifish
item:Fish12.description: Astonishingly, despite its unthreatening exterior of cauliflower and bread, this creature sits atop the food chain according to leading IdleOn Oceanographers. At least, based on currently explored seas...

item:Fish13.name: Equinox_Fish
item:Fish13.description: Straight from the Equinox Valley river, the scales shimmer and shine in an almost impossible way.

item:Bug1.name: Fly
item:Bug1.description: I don't know whyyyy she swallowed a flyyy, perhaps she'll cry from being perpetually made fun of in the form of a nursey rhyme just because she made one bad decision... er, die!

item:Bug2.name: Butterfly
item:Bug2.description: Butter Fly? Get it??? Sorry... I promise I wont make this kind of joke again

item:Bug3.name: Sentient_Cereal
item:Bug3.description: Honestly, I was shocked too at first when I learned that cereal in real life was harvested from Cereal Bugs. Seriously, look it up! Most cereal before 1960 were made from harvested Cereal Bug Nests!

item:Bug4.name: Fruitfly
item:Bug4.description: Hahaha I had my fingers crossed!

item:Bug5.name: Mosquisnow
item:Bug5.description: I'm so tired of all these blood sucking vermin in IdleOn... and these mosquisnow bugs are annoying too!

item:Bug6.name: Flycicle
item:Bug6.description: Ok these bugs are really not making any sense anymore.

item:Bug7.name: Worker_Bee
item:Bug7.description: It's a bee and it's working. As per the Worker Bee Union Act of 1977, I am barred from making any pun or joke about them.

item:Bug8.name: Fairy
item:Bug8.description: It glows with the joy of a being that knows it's not real, but continues to exist anyway.

item:Bug9.name: Scarab
item:Bug9.description: Amazingly, these bugs have adapted around being static images with no animation, and are able to fly without moving their wings!

item:Bug10.name: Dust_Mote
item:Bug10.description: Wait, is this actually just a piece of dust? I mean it's classified as a bug but like, I mean... the classifiers must get it wrong sometimes right?

item:Bug11.name: Dream_Particulate
item:Bug11.description: It's a fluttering piece of solid dream. This thing right here could really do some damage if only dreams were real and not made up by the powers that be...

item:Bug12.name: Ladybug
item:Bug12.description: The black polkadot pattern is there to scare away predators. Fortunately for you, you're not scared of black dots!

item:Bug13.name: Firefly
item:Bug13.description: As you gaze upon the firefly's majesty, you simply CANNOT BELIEVE YOUR EYEEES.

item:Bug15.name: Litterbug
item:Bug15.description: The way they shimmer in the light and reflect the environmental destruction caused by the packaged goods industry fills you with a sense of awe.

item:Critter1.name: Froge
item:Critter1.description: The living embodiment of the classic cryptocurrency 'Frogecoin'. Very ribbit, much green, wow!!

item:Critter1A.name: Poison_Froge
item:Critter1A.description: Ew, it's the living embodiment of that scam alt-coin crypto ripoff, 'Frogecoin Cash'

item:Critter2.name: Crabbo
item:Critter2.description: Argg, yer spendin' all me money!

item:Critter2A.name: Mutant_Crabbo
item:Critter2A.description: Argghgg, yershpend inall memuh knee!!... Yea, mutants can't speak very well, probably on account of the radiation poisioning and all that.

item:Critter3.name: Scorpie
item:Critter3.description: This cutie will stab its way into your heart if you aren't careful! No seriosuly, be careful, the bugger pricked my foot the other day and it hurt bad.

item:Critter3A.name: Crescent_Scorpie
item:Critter3A.description: This chrome coloured scorpion came straight from the future! Fuuuutuuuuureee! FUUTUUURREE!!! SOMEONE DIRECT ME TO THE CAN OPENERRRR!!!!

item:Critter4.name: Mousey
item:Critter4.description: Adorable!!! Look how cute it's tail is, and that itty bitty nose, and the fact that it's a mouse and not a rat so I don't want to hit it with a broom!

item:Critter4A.name: Nakeo_Moleo
item:Critter4A.description: This mole ain't got no fur! Ew, gross!! Disgusting even!!! What kind of wretched abomination has skin but no thick layer of fur??

item:Critter5.name: Owlio
item:Critter5.description: Hoot hoot! Yea thats all I got for this one.

item:Critter5A.name: Minervowl
item:Critter5A.description: It's a more expensive hoot, I guess. I ain't got no jokes for owls, they're too cool.

item:Critter6.name: Pingy
item:Critter6.description: It's basically just Gunter but with RTX off.

item:Critter6A.name: Eternal_Lord_of_The_Undying_Ember
item:Critter6A.description: Bow before the destroyer of all that lies outside his domain, the ruler of the 8th dimension and all that it's flame encompasses, the bringer of light to the blind, and darkness to those who recite his title in full. ...ah crap.

item:Critter7.name: Bunny
item:Critter7.description: It could use a carrot, the lil' guy needs some food!

item:Critter7A.name: Purbunni
item:Critter7A.description: The other bunny is brilliant... But I like this one more.

item:Critter8.name: Dung_Beat
item:Critter8.description: You lean closer to the critter, and hear it say 'Dodo tshh do dodo tss dodo tss badabada dodoooo'. So no, that name isn't a typo.

item:Critter8A.name: Jade_Scarab
item:Critter8A.description: Oh I guess this one is a scarab, not a beetle. You can tell because of the way it is.

item:Critter9A.name: Diamond_Duck
item:Critter9A.description: One of the only beings strong enough to take on the Eternal Lord of the Undying Ember realm. Their battle would be legendary.

item:Critter10A.name: Voodofish
item:Critter10A.description: Yo bro I ain't touchin' that thing ain't no way!

item:Critter11A.name: Tottoise
item:Critter11A.description: He out here livin' his best life! No he doesn't look familiar, you're just being silly. Very silly.

item:Soul1.name: Forest_Soul
item:Soul1.description: The soul moans ooOOOOooOOOoo, because it's the only key on his keyboard that works.

item:Soul2.name: Dune_Soul
item:Soul2.description: Fat chonker this one is! It must be the moonmoon diet these ghosts have, they should start eating some of those fruits for a change!

item:Soul3.name: Rooted_Soul
item:Soul3.description: It's smiling as if it knows something that you don't...

item:Soul4.name: Frigid_Soul
item:Soul4.description: Well, his mom did warn him if that he kept making funny faces that it'd freeze that way!

item:Soul5.name: Squishy_Soul
item:Soul5.description: Don't judge their expression, you'd be mad too if someone squished YOU into that weirdo lookin' pattern!

item:Soul6.name: Oozie_Soul
item:Soul6.description: He be oozin' and cruisin' and ain't worried 'bout nothin'

item:Soul7.name: Breezy_Soul
item:Soul7.description: Calm thoughts, wavy clouds, he just wanna fly.

item:Soul8.name: Deepsea_Soul
item:Soul8.description: I bet this octopus fella has quite the garden, I'd love to be there! In the shade, under the sea... that'd be so great...!

item:SnowB3.description: Click the pen on, then hold it down against your desk and let go, and BAM that baby will fly you straight to the principal's office!

item:SnowB4.name: Cracked_Glass
item:SnowB4.description: Ah Mr. Thermostat, not looking so hot now that I've broken you into tiny little bits... no seriously, I can't tell the temperature now that you're broken.

item:SnowC1.name: Sippy_Straw
item:SnowC1.description: This vacuum operated liquid transfer system is capable of dispencing over 500 mL of dangerous dihydrogen monoxide chemical compounds from one end to the other!

item:SnowC2.name: Cryosnake_Skin
item:SnowC2.description: Wow this is just a cheap recolouring of the normal snakeskin! I want my money back!

item:SnowC3.name: Audio_Cord
item:SnowC3.description: Uhhhh... which one which one...?? The red or the blue??? Cmon think think think.. Blue...? 'BOOOOOM'. Wait, this is an audio cord description? Whoops, I thought this was the Bomb Defuser description!!

item:SnowC4.name: Contact_Lense
item:SnowC4.description: It's the only transparent item in IdleOn! If they weren't, they'd just be pirate eyepatches after all...

item:SnowC4a.name: Black_Lense
item:SnowC4a.description: Why yes, I have also played that game for 100s of hours since it released over 10 years ago!

item:SnowC5.name: Blood_Bone
item:SnowC5.description: Wait a minute, these are just regular bones painted red! Wait another minute, no, that's actual blood... ew.

item:GalaxyA1.name: Purple_Mush_Cap
item:GalaxyA1.description: According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.

item:GalaxyA2.name: TV_Remote
item:GalaxyA2.description: Oh, THATS where he put the remote, all the way out here in outer space thousands of miles from the surface! Oh that silly man!

item:GalaxyA2b.name: Lost_Batteries
item:GalaxyA2b.description: Oh, THATS why the remote wasn't working when I pushed the buttons, the batteries were all the way out here in the rare drop table!

item:GalaxyA3.name: Half_Eaten_Donut
item:GalaxyA3.description: WAIT NO STOP! Don't eat the rest of this donut! Think about it... if it was really worth eating, why was it left like this, all un-eaten and such? Think before you eat!

item:GalaxyA4.name: Genie_Lamp
item:GalaxyA4.description: Rub it, maybe a genie will come out! Oh wait, you already killed the genie. Maybe try 'not murder' next time.

item:GalaxyB1.name: Bottle_Cap
item:GalaxyB1.description: With the main prey of the Soda Can being the Soda Bottle, one can conclude that bottle caps are indigestible, and will remain untarnished after being consumed.

item:GalaxyB3.name: Tongue_Bone
item:GalaxyB3.description: The tongue is wrapped around the bone.

item:GalaxyB4.name: Crumpled_Wrapper
item:GalaxyB4.description: Yo... yuhhh, yea, yea. They said I was doomed from the start, maaan ain't no wrapper made it past the worst part...

item:GalaxyB5.name: Smol_Worm
item:GalaxyB5.description: I wonder if this one's an undercover agent too...

item:GalaxyC1.name: Empty_Oyster_Shell
item:GalaxyC1.description: It's a lame shell that's been desaturated due to it's unimportance.

item:GalaxyC1b.name: Pearler_Shell
item:GalaxyC1b.description: Yow wow wow! This one's got a pearl in it!!

item:GalaxyC2.name: Wriggly_Ball
item:GalaxyC2.description: It's like some sort of tentankle ball. Hang on, let me try that again. It's like some sort of tentacle ball.

item:GalaxyC4.name: Condensed_Zap
item:GalaxyC4.description: ...37 Megawatts of electricity, if my voltmeter reading is correct!

item:Quest17.name: Amarok_Slab
item:Quest17.description: A piece of rock from the big bad wolf himself. Careful, it's overflowing with green plasma energy! No wait, that's just some moss.

item:Quest29.name: Chaotic_Amarok_Slab
item:Quest29.description: A piece of rock from the bigger badder wolf himself. Careful, it's overflowing with poisonous ooze! No wait, that's just plasma energy...

item:EfauntDrop1.name: Ripped_Tunic
item:EfauntDrop1.description: A piece of Efaunt's tunic. I guess it must have gotten torn off while you were absolutely obliterating them with big time Damage.

item:EfauntDrop2.name: Ribbed_Tunic
item:EfauntDrop2.description: Chaotic Efaunt is probably glad you removed a few of his ribs, for uhh... various reasons.

item:Chiz0.name: Chizoar_Spike
item:Chiz0.description: A spike from Chizoar's neck. It's ice cold, and sharp as a tack.

item:Chiz1.name: Chizoar_Stalagmite
item:Chiz1.description: A spike from Chaotic Chizoar's neck. Despite it being made of ice, it burns at the touch due to its acidity.

item:TrollPart.name: Troll_Scales
item:TrollPart.description: Even the scales look like they have a wry smile, almost as if it remembers the part it played in that infamous tutorial prank you were unfortunately involved in

item:KrukPart.name: Kruk_Tooth
item:KrukPart.description: Extracted straight from the horses mouth! At least I think he was a horse... maybe a buffalo? It came from a mouth at the very least.

item:KrukPart2.name: Kruk_Cavity_Tooth
item:KrukPart2.description: I guess proper dental hygiene isn't one of the requirements to becoming a Divinity.

item:EmpPart.name: Emperor_Ribbon
item:EmpPart.description: So, instead of taking his equipment directly, you take his ribbon... so that you can... make his equipment? Huh?

item:LavaA1.name: Suggma_Ashes
item:LavaA1.description: Poor suggma slug, couldn't even handle a little bit of water eh?

item:LavaA1b.name: Royal_Suggma_Urn
item:LavaA1b.description: Huh... was uh... was that one some sort of king or something? This species really needs to sort out its heirarchy, it didn't look any different from the others!

item:LavaA2.name: Plated_Crumbs
item:LavaA2.description: Look if you're gonna kill the poor thing, you may as well have the decency of finishing the whole thing!

item:LavaA3.name: Sundried_Glass
item:LavaA3.description: Reduced to mere glass fragments... I guess thats just the price he pays for being a monster, his destiny was calling.

item:LavaA4.name: Cheesy_Crumbs
item:LavaA4.description: Thats not your cheese! Err, thats nacho cheese! Ok wow that really doesn't work typed out like that...

item:LavaA5.name: Stilt_Pole
item:LavaA5.description: It's got a built in gyroscope to help with balance. Unfortunately, it isn't turned on.

item:LavaB1.name: Meteorite
item:LavaB1.description: It's like a meatball served in tomato sauce... lets eat!

item:LavaB2.name: Shattered_Skull
item:LavaB2.description: So, is this pile of crumbs still 1 skull, or like a thousand skulls? At what point when crumbling does a skull stop being a skull?

item:LavaB3.name: Orange_Slice
item:LavaB3.description: So this is where all those Youth Sports get their half time snacks!

item:LavaB5.name: Spitfire
item:LavaB5.description: Ew, that's basically its saliva! Why are you keeping it in your inventory?? Ugh whatever...

item:LavaC1.name: Wormie_Slices
item:LavaC1.description: Where are the green eggs to go with these?

item:SpiA1.name: Leafy_Droplet
item:SpiA1.description: It's more of a gel than a liquid, but strangely when you pull the leaf out it loses its rigidity.

item:SpiA2.name: Rice_Cake
item:SpiA2.description: A single slice of a rice cake. Despite seemingly being made of 90 percent air, some people really enjoy these.

item:SpiA2b.name: Stacked_Rice_Cake
item:SpiA2b.description: A single slice of a rice cake, but with another single slice of rice cake attached underneath the first single slice of rice! There's also a single slice of orange sauce, if you can call liquid a slice. Want me to say slice again?

item:SpiA3.name: Bamboo
item:SpiA3.description: You stole this from a hard working water spirit... but carrying bamboo is not what water is meant to do, so it had it coming, that silly water!

item:SpiA4.name: Leafy_Horn
item:SpiA4.description: You took the baby troll's beloved horn, but you didn't even have the decency to ask first? I guess MANNERS isn't a skill in Worlds 1 to 5 huh...

item:SpiA5.name: Wooden_Aortic_Mass
item:SpiA5.description: It sits motionless, unbeating, blood not being pumped. It's made of wood, so this doesn't come as a surprise.

item:SpiB1.name: Leafy_Branch
item:SpiB1.description: Eleven leaves, one branch. If we had 14 more branches, and took off 3 leaves from each branch, how many seconds in total would be wasted figuring out how many leaves there are? 15, cuz there are 120 leaves.

item:SpiB2.name: Light_Lantern
item:SpiB2.description: I think it says... OTL? One Time Lucky? But I want to be lucky MORE than once... better wipe out some more lantern spirits!

item:SpiB2b.name: Dark_Lantern
item:SpiB2b.description: Oh NO! I know what THAT means, thats AWFUL!! That puts the light lantern in context, thats for sure...

item:SpiB3.name: Troll_Flower
item:SpiB3.description: Now I know what you're thinking, and yes it is indeed part of its head and not a hat.

item:SpiB4.name: Chopped_Leek
item:SpiB4.description: Wow ok this is way more gruesome with context than without...

item:SpiC2.name: Eviscerated_Chunk
item:SpiC2.description: Ouch! I don't think we have a big enough bandaid for the poor fella!

item:SpiD1.name: Royal_Yolk
item:SpiD1.description: Sometimes it's fun to poke at the yellow outisde and watch the yellow insides ooze out...

item:SpiD2.name: Royal_Fabric
item:SpiD2.description: Now I know what you're thinking, and yes it is indeed part of its elegant hat and not part of its head.

item:SpiD3.name: Royal_Headpiece
item:SpiD3.description: It shines bright and true, to signify how dope n' epic ninjas are, heck yea.

item:w7A1.name: Equinox_Flesh
item:w7A1.description: On the plus side, it reflects light in a cool way. On the minus side, that probably makes it carcinogenic...

item:w7A2.name: Doodlefins
item:w7A2.description: The fin really is the most iconic part of the Doodlefish!

item:w7A3.name: Earl_Tail
item:w7A3.description: Earl ain't got no tail no more.

item:w7A4.name: Cracked_Shell
item:w7A4.description: You can't make a perfect Deathnote score without breaking a few slug shells!

item:w7A5.name: Scaled_Fragment
item:w7A5.description: The balloon floated away, so these scales are all you get!

item:w7A6.name: Clammy_Chunk
item:w7A6.description: It's a chunk of clam... literally. Clam shells are basically clam skin, it's not like clams find a shell to call home, it's part of their body.

item:w7A7.name: Plastic_Litter
item:w7A7.description: People really do just litter... the world is their trash can, I guess.

item:w7A8.name: Pufferflesh
item:w7A8.description: The spots are actually taste-buds, strangely enough!

item:w7A10.name: Fishfork
item:w7A10.description: The fish survived being speared, but couldn't survive you!

item:w7A11.name: Crabclaw
item:w7A11.description: Wow... keep away from these guys on St Patrick's Day if you're not wearing green!

item:w7A12.name: Guardian_Mace
item:w7A12.description: Very well made, considering it's made by Crabkind.

item:w7B1.name: Eye_of_Koi
item:w7B1.description: It's a glass eye, which means you're violently decimating a population of blind defensle... oh wait no, it's a real eyeball.

item:w7B1b.name: Immaculate_Eye
item:w7B1b.description: Woah... I bet someone out there would value such a thing quite highly!

item:w7B2.name: Bubble_N_Chains
item:w7B2.description: Take awayyyyyyy... take away this bubble and chain!

item:w7B3.name: Pirate_Emblem_I
item:w7B3.description: The very first emblem given to new pirates, signifying their alliance to the pirate crew.

item:w7B4.name: Caviar
item:w7B4.description: Ooooohhhohoh, unborn fish in circular form, how sumptuous!

item:w7B5.name: Jelly_Cube
item:w7B5.description: Wibble wobble wibble wobble wibble wobble wibble wobble wibble wobble wibble wobble wibble wobble

item:w7B6.name: Tuft_of_Kelp
item:w7B6.description: Kelpfish as you know them are actually female... as for the male fish, well, you're looking at a group of them. Confused? Look up male anglerfish...

item:w7B7.name: Mantacakes
item:w7B7.description: I don't care what message of tastiness and goodness you send me, I will not endorse this food.

item:w7B8.name: Glowfish_Tail
item:w7B8.description: It'll keep glowing so long as it believes in itself.

item:w7B9.name: Ancient_Scales
item:w7B9.description: It's a writhing pile of scales, gems, and extremities.

item:w7B10.name: Magmaspike
item:w7B10.description: What would hurt more, the stab wound or the burn wound?

item:w7B11.name: Pirate_Mark_II
item:w7B11.description: The second emblem given to veteran pirates, signifying their loyalty to the pirate crew.

item:w7B11b.name: Pirate_Anchor
item:w7B11b.description: Things would get even messier in the Mess Hall without these bad boys tying them down!

item:w7B12.name: Pirate_Mark_III
item:w7B12.description: The ultimate emblem given to legendary pirates, signifying their leadership of the pirate crew.

item:w7B12b.name: Pirate_Ship_Figurine
item:w7B12b.description: Wait, are these guys captains of the sunken ship or THIS ship??

item:GemP35.name: Hyper_Obol_Stack_Square_Edition
item:GemP35.description: Hold down and 1 square hyper obol will drop at your feet! YOU MUST BE IN WORLD 2 TOWN TO USE THIS! This way you can trash other obols incase you're out of space!

item:Key1.name: Forest_Villa_Key
item:Key1.description: Hold down to add these Forest Boss Keys to your account. Account items are shared between all your Characters!

item:Key2.name: Efaunt's_Tomb_Key
item:Key2.description: Hold down to add these Desert Boss Keys to your account.

item:Key3.name: Chizoar's_Cavern_Key
item:Key3.description: Hold down to add these Tundra Boss Keys to your account.

item:Key4.name: Troll's_Enclave_Key
item:Key4.description: Hold down to add these Nebula Boss Keys to your account.

item:Key5.name: Kruk's_Volcano_Key
item:Key5.description: Hold down to add these Plateau Boss Keys to your account.

item:ObolFrag.description: Hold down to add these Obol Fragments to your account. Account items are shared between all your Characters!

item:DoubleAFKtix.name: Double_AFK_Gain_Ticket
item:DoubleAFKtix.description: Hold down to add these Double AFK tickets to your account. Account items are shared between all your Characters!

item:TixCol.name: Colosseum_Ticket
item:TixCol.description: Hold down to add these Colosseum tickets to your account. Account items are shared between all your Characters!

item:DeliveryBox.name: Delivery_Box
item:DeliveryBox.description: Hold down to add these Delivery Boxes to your Post-Office Upgrade amount! These will be shared between all your Characters!

item:SilverPen.name: Silver_Pen
item:SilverPen.description: Hold down to add a Silver Pen to your Post-Office! You can use it to skip a Delivery!

item:PremiumGem.name: Gem
item:PremiumGem.description: Hold down to add these gems to your account. You can then spend them in the Gem Shop!

item:TalentPoint1.name: Talent_Point_Tab_1
item:TalentPoint1.description: Hold down to gain a Talent Point for the first tab of talents. THIS APPLIES TO ALL CHARACTERS, even ones you haven't made yet, so it doesn't matter which character uses this item.

item:TalentPoint2.name: Talent_Point_Tab_2
item:TalentPoint2.description: Hold down to gain a Talent Point for the second tab of talents. THIS APPLIES TO ALL CHARACTERS, even ones you haven't made yet, so it doesn't matter which character uses this item.

item:TalentPoint3.description: Hold down to gain a Talent Point for the third tab of talents. THIS APPLIES TO ALL CHARACTERS, even ones you haven't made yet, so it doesn't matter which character uses this item.

item:Gfoodcoupon.name: Gold_Food_Coupon
item:Gfoodcoupon.description: Hold down to receive a random golden food!

item:GfoodcouponS.name: Statue_Coupon
item:GfoodcouponS.description: Hold down to receive a random Statue! Rumor has it that... well... I shouldn't spread rumors, that's outside of my Job Description!

item:ItemsCoupon1.name: Resource_Coupon
item:ItemsCoupon1.description: Hold down, and a resource stack will drop on the floor! YOU MUST MANUALLY PICK UP THE RESOURCE ON THE GROUND

item:ItemsCoupon2.name: Really_Really_Resource_Coupon
item:ItemsCoupon2.description: Hold down, and a resource stack will drop on the floor! YOU MUST MANUALLY PICK UP THE RESOURCE ON THE GROUND

item:Quest14.name: Employment_Statistics
item:Quest14.description: Wait a minute, these stats have misleading Y-axes and invalid sampling methods! Even then, they show no clear evidence for rats stealing jobs! How could anyone possibly believe this data?

item:Quest15.name: Red_Frisbee
item:Quest15.description: Sprout's red frisbee! I hope you didn't get shrunken down by a magic apple on your way up, or your stetchy dog brother might laugh at you!

item:Quest16.name: Broken_Mic
item:Quest16.description: The guy who carelessly dropped this microphone is a moron, and that's a fact. Boom, mic drop... ah crap.

item:Quest18.name: Loomi's_Room_Key
item:Quest18.description: A key to a door, but there are still more! Why so many? They were on sale for a penny!

item:Quest19.name: Golden_Dubloon
item:Quest19.description: Avast, land lubber! This coin be property of the YumYum Sea Pirates! Ye best be returning it, lest ye want an underwater funeral, arg!

item:Quest20.name: Signed_Arrest_Warrant
item:Quest20.description: That's weird, Bandit Bob's signature looks an awful lot like yours...

item:Quest21.name: Time_Thingy
item:Quest21.description: Yea yea I know, this quest doesn't really make sense. Although, if you reeeaaally think about it, you'll realize that it still makes no sense... so it's best not to think about it!

item:Quest22.name: Corporatube_Sub
item:Quest22.description: Represents a single subscriber on the Corporatube Video Platform. It You'sed to be called something else, but no one around here remembers.

item:Quest23.name: Instablab_Follower
item:Quest23.description: Represents a single follower on Instablab, who probably sound like this: 'Oh mah gawd Becky, you would not Buh Leeeeve how lame this game I'm playing is. They have a joke about Insta that tooootally isn't funnay, like seriouslayy!

item:Quest24.name: Cloudsound_Follower
item:Quest24.description: Represents a single follower on Cloudsound. This isn't a website, it's literally a giant cloud that emits sound that people enjoy following around. Why, what were YOU thinking this was?

item:Quest25.name: Birthday_Card
item:Quest25.description: Hold down to read the card! There's a 1 in 75 chance it contains a Birthday Hat recipe, and a 74 in 75 chance it contains a... well, grandma is a bit off these days, so it'll probably be a mushroom cap.

item:Quest26.name: Pre_Crime_Box
item:Quest26.description: The traditional gift given to those about to be victimized. A favorite amongst criminals!

item:Quest27.name: Bag_o_Nuts
item:Quest27.description: Mmmmm, these nuts are so yuuuummy!

item:Quest28.name: IOU_one_W7_Crystal
item:Quest28.description: Victorious as you are, I cannot give you the crystal to unlock World 7 at this time. Come fight me later, and I will give to you the W7 crystal.

item:GoldricP1.name: Casual_Confidante
item:GoldricP1.description: It's a painting of a strangely out of place gold bar fellow. They look nervous underneath their outward bravado.

item:KeyFrag.name: Keychain_Fragment
item:KeyFrag.description: Hold down on these to add them to your account. You'll be spending these in the next update to buy keychains at the Keychain Pile, which will be in the next update!

item:DungCredits1.name: Dungeon_Credits
item:DungCredits1.description: Hold down to add these to your account. You can spend dungeon credits in any Dungeon Hub!

item:ClassSwap.name: Sub_Class_Swap_Token
item:ClassSwap.description: Hold down on this item to change sub class within your class. It won't let you change classes, that will be done a different way in the future...

item:ClassSwapB.name: Elite_Class_Swap_Token
item:ClassSwapB.description: Hold down on this item to change elite class within your class. Divine Knight to Blood Berserker, Beast Master to Siege Breaker, etc.

item:ClassSwapC.name: Complete_Class_Redo_Token
item:ClassSwapC.description: YOU MUST TAKE OFF EQUIPMENT TO USE THIS. Hold down on this item to become a Lv 1 beginner again. You can then redo the promotion quests to choose a new class!

item:ResetBox.name: Post_Office_Box_Reseto_Magnifico
item:ResetBox.description: Hold down to reset all post office upgrades made on this character! You'll get all the Box Points refunded of course, no problemo!

item:Ht.name: Hat_Premiumifier
item:Ht.description: Drag this onto any normal hat to turn it into a premium hat! Doing so will wipe all it's stats, and give it +1 all stat and 5 Premium Upgrade Slots, just like any other premium hat.

item:StonePremRestore.name: Premium_Stone_Refunder
item:StonePremRestore.description: Drag this onto any Premium Hat to refund all Premium Stones used on it. You must have at least 4 open inventory spaces to use this btw

item:StonePremStatswap.name: Premium_Bonus_Swapper
item:StonePremStatswap.description: Put this stone in your inventory, with 2 premium hats to its left and right. Then hold down on the stone to swap their special bonuses! Also works with regular hats made premium by the Hat Premiumifier

item:ExpBalloon1.name: Small_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon1.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:ExpBalloon2.name: Medium_Experience_Balloon

item:ExpBalloon3.name: Large_Experience_Balloon

item:JobApplication.name: Job_Application
item:JobApplication.description: It's a registration form for the job of Sanitation Comissioner. One of the requirements is being able to pick up dog poop without immediately throwing the bag on the ground afterward.

item:SmithingHammerChisel.name: Sculpting_Tools
item:SmithingHammerChisel.description: You gotta embrace the marble! You gotta sniff the marble! You gotta lick the marble! You gotta wash the marble! You gotta BE THE MARBLE!

item:SmithingHammerChisel2.name: Guilding_Tools
item:SmithingHammerChisel2.description: Drop this on the statue man, and you'll turn him to gold and unlock Golden Statues!

item:SmithingHammerChisel3.name: Onyx_Tools
item:SmithingHammerChisel3.description: Drop this on the statue man, and you'll turn him to onyx and unlock the ability to trade in statues for Onyx rank!

item:SmithingHammerChisel4.name: Zenith_Tools
item:SmithingHammerChisel4.description: Drop this on the statue man, and you'll unlock the ability to drop stacks of 1 Million Statues for Zenith rank! Also unlocks Zenith Cluster Farming, talk to Zenelith in World 7 for more info.!

item:BobJoePickle.name: BobJoePickle
item:BobJoePickle.description: He was one of the good ones... Alas he is now just a pickle. Good for scaring a cat though!

item:BallJoePickle.name: BallJoePickle
item:BallJoePickle.description: What have they done to ya BobJoe?

item:BoneJoePickle.name: BoneJoePickle
item:BoneJoePickle.description: He cackles, he spooks, and he... multiplies miniboss HP by 1.10x!? And he STACKS with other BoneJoePickles??!

item:Quest1.name: Mining_Certificate
item:Quest1.description: Proof that you passed Glumlee's tutorial quests. It's worthless.

item:Crystal1.name: Desert_Topaz
item:Crystal1.description: Give this to the bird in town to unlock the portal to World 2! You can come back to World 1 whenever you want, don't worry.

item:Crystal2.name: Glacier_Quartz
item:Crystal2.description: Restores power to the Glacial Portal in the desert town, allowing travel to World 3!

item:Crystal3.name: Galaxial_Amethyst
item:Crystal3.description: Restores power to the Galaxy Portal in the glacier town, allowing travel to World 4!

item:Crystal4.name: Magma_Geode
item:Crystal4.description: Restores power to the Magma Portal in the galaxy town, allowing travel to World 5!

item:Crystal5.name: Spirit_Diamond
item:Crystal5.description: Restores power to the Spirit Portal in the magma rivertown, allowing travel to World 6!

item:Crystal6.name: Gem_to_W7
item:Crystal6.description: Restores power to the W7 Portal in the spirit village, allowing travel to World 7!

item:PeanutS.name: Stone_Peanut
item:PeanutS.description: It's like a regular peanut, except it's made of stone instead of pea. I bet a Rocklyte would enjoy it!

item:Quest3.name: Ketchup_Bottle
item:Quest3.description: A tiny ketchup bottle, small enough for a Frog to use. Would go great with some Mustard!

item:Quest4.name: Mustard_Bottle
item:Quest4.description: A tiny mustard bottle, small enough for a Frog to never use because mustard is gross. Would go great with some Ketchup!

item:Mayo.name: Mayonnaise_Bottle
item:Mayo.description: Why did someone bury a bottle of mayo? Wait... why did you go dig it up??

item:Trash2.name: Dried_Paint_Blob
item:Trash2.description: Its all hard and crusty now.

item:Trash3.name: Engraved_Bullet
item:Trash3.description: It's a bullet, and it's got your name on it!

item:Quest5.name: Class_Certificate
item:Quest5.description: Proof that you selected a class! You're on your way to the top, this is just the beginning!

item:Quest6.name: Scouting_Report
item:Quest6.description: It says a Giant Wolf-like Golem was seen walking with the gem even deeper into the Jungle. Stiltzcho has purposefully smudged his signature so that it's not readable.

item:Quest7.name: Strange_Rock
item:Quest7.description: Looks like the piece of a golem. It even has 'Made In Golemtopia' engraved on the side of it.

item:Quest10.name: Green_Tea
item:Quest10.description: You're playing a game right now with a sub-plot that involves a jar of sand falling in love with a cup of tea. Just thought I'd point that out.

item:Quest11.name: Forest_Villas_Flyer_Thingy
item:Quest11.description: Solid evidence that it's possible to have a negative crafting level.

item:Quest12.name: Wood_Board_Bone
item:Quest12.description: Dog Bone will give you Boss Keys once you collect a few of these! Idk why they named a ghost after these bones... or were these bones named after the ghost?

item:Quest13.name: Empty_Box
item:Quest13.description: An empty box, the perfect place to put all your Hermit Cans, Megalodon teeth, and pure water... that you don't have anymore haha!

item:GoldricP2.name: Triumphant_Treason
item:GoldricP2.description: It's a rendition of the Battle of Sassasge, wherein Goldrichius Von Gallbladder waged war on the municipal kingdom of Sterling S. Elvar

item:GoldricP3.name: Claiming_Cashe
item:GoldricP3.description: The victory portrait of King Goldrichius Sr. after successfully dethroning S.S. Elvar from the East Yum-Yum dunedaries.

item:Quest30.name: Giftmas_Box
item:Quest30.description: Hold down to open! There's a santa hat in one of these, as well as various holiday exclusive goodies, even cards!

item:Quest31.name: Gem_Note
item:Quest31.description: Did you like those 20 gems you just picked up? Well you'll LOVE the 500 gems I just added to your account. This paper is worthless btw lol it's just a picture of a gem.

item:Cutter.name: Bolt_Cutters
item:Cutter.description: I bet if you dropped these on a sewer grating, it would snap the bars right off!

item:Quest32.name: Monster_Rating
item:Quest32.description: 'I literally just die over and over, I can't even fight back other than just running into them. Honestly I wish I was dead, but even then I just keep respawning, literally the worst experience ever, 1 star!!'

item:Quest33.name: Player_Rating_With_Letter_P
item:Quest33.description: 'WTF y do my items CONSTANTLY DISAPPEAR I HATE IT!! Complete RUBBISH! 1 STAR UNTIL YOU FIX MY SPECIFIC PROBLEM and even then I'll probably just raise it to 2 stars lol'

item:Quest34.name: Player_Rating_With_Letter_S
item:Quest34.description: 'This is NOT an Idle game! I actually have to play it sometimes! And why are there actual pictures on the screen, instead of just words and text boxes?? I can't believe I paid 0 dollars for this trash!'

item:Quest35.name: Googley_Eyes
item:Quest35.description: I remember when I was a kid, I spent an HOUR making a GLASS container look like it was a little friend using googley eyes just like these! If only there was a CONTAINER in this game, so you could do it to!

item:Quest36.name: Dootjat_Eye
item:Quest36.description: Blinks repeatedly when close to the Black Market, where you buy the Ankh used in the ice zone to get the Hedjet... wait, wrong game, sorry!

item:Quest37.name: Silver_Antique
item:Quest37.description: An old lady pawned it off to the bazaar claiming it was some 'ancient artifact of the pharoah King Doot'. It's probably just scrap metal, doubt it's even real silver. Would make for a decent Necklace!

item:Quest38.name: Guild_Giftbox
item:Quest38.description: Hold down to open! Contains a random cool-kid item, like gems, exp balloons, or even time candy! Also, 1 in every 500 gifts contains the 'Ultra Unboxer' Trophy!

item:Quest39.name: Lovey_Dovey_Letter
item:Quest39.description: Hold down on a letter to spawn a Valenslime!

item:Quest40.name: Choco_Box
item:Quest40.description: Hold down to open a random reward! Possibilites include Gems, exclusive hats, event food, event cards, and more!

item:Quest41.name: Flowies
item:Quest41.description: Curse you flowey! I trusted you, I accepted your pellets of friendship, and then you had to go and throw it all away! And now here you are, trying to take over yet another video game... well I NOT GONNA LE-- oh wait, these are just normal flowers

item:Quest42.name: Egg_Capsule
item:Quest42.description: Hold down to open for a random reward! Or, hold down for a LONG time to open them faster... yea, dreams do come true

item:Quest43.name: Gummy_Bunny
item:Quest43.description: Hold down to summon a friendly easter monster. But be careful, unlike real life where all friends are genuine, these monsters are just pretending to be your friend for personal gain!

item:Quest44.name: Goldegg_Capsule
item:Quest44.description: Hold down to summon a mini boss or a green mushroom. It's a 50 50 shot which one you get!

item:Quest45.name: Sesame_Seed
item:Quest45.description: The key to Bandit Bob's Party Dungeon! No not that dungeon... you're thinking of Snakenhotep's Dungeon, this one's for Bandit Bob's dungeon. So yea, this is worthless.

item:Quest46.name: The_Bobber_Challenge_Scroll
item:Quest46.description: A great behemoth has emerged from its slumber... and it now roams the fishing minigame! If you catch 2 whales, then purposefully avoid catching the 3rd whale, the ocean behemoth will eventually appear! Catch it to win a trophy!

item:Quest47.name: Elderly_Peanut
item:Quest47.description: It has a very peculiar stench... the smell is so unbearable, your damage is lowered by 50% and your Max HP is just 1! Only the sands of a dead Biggie Hours Miniboss could reverse the aging this peanut has undergone!

item:Quest48.name: Pete_the_Peanut
item:Quest48.description: Now that's a happy looking peanut! I wish he was MY best friend, but no one wants to be friends with sentient item dialogue ^

item:Quest49.name: Summer_Cooler
item:Quest49.description: Hold down to open for a random reward! Or, hold down for a LONG time to open them faster.

item:Quest50.name: Beach_Oyster
item:Quest50.description: Hold down to summon a bunch of Summer Monsters, and get a random Pearl!

item:Quest88.name: Golden_Oyster
item:Quest88.description: Hold down to get a random special reward! Event Points do not expire, you keep all unspent Event Points for next event!

item:Pearl4.name: Black_Pearl

item:Pearl5.name: Holy_Pearl
item:Pearl5.description: Hold down to gain Class EXP. The amount you gain is based on your Class LV.

item:Pearl6.name: Divinity_Pearl
item:Pearl6.description: Hold down to gain 40% EXP in the current skill you're doing! If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. Only works on skills below level 50. IMPORTANT: This cannot be used for skills in World 5 or beyond.

item:Quest56.name: Dootophone
item:Quest56.description: Hold down on this vintage Dootophone to active all the obelisks on Doot's burial platform at once!

item:Quest57.name: Damaged_Cog
item:Quest57.description: Hold down on this cog to turn it into a Refurbished Cog, IF you have a construction LV of 75+.

item:Quest58.name: Refurbished_Cog
item:Quest58.description: Made from a Damaged Cog, which you can buy at the Town Shop!

item:Quest59.name: Shuvelle's_Vote
item:Quest59.description: A slip of paper indicating that a Ms. Shuvelle La Deuge intends to vote for Mayor Hoggindaz

item:Quest60.name: Yondergreens_Vote
item:Quest60.description: A slip of paper indicating that a Sir Yondergreen Von Timberbottom intends to vote for Mayor Hoggindaz

item:Quest61.name: Bill_Brr's_Vote
item:Quest61.description: A slip of paper indicating that a Mr. Bill Brr doesn't intend to vote for any of these political puppets, but he left it blank so you filled it in for Hoggi.

item:Quest62.name: Signed_Contract
item:Quest62.description: It's the last will and testament of some penguin monster. Just pretend you signed it, ol' Yondergreen seems a little blind and probably wont notice.

item:Quest64.name: 2021_Giftmas_Box
item:Quest64.description: Hold to open! Contains a random Giftmas goodie, from event cards to foods!

item:Quest65.name: Pile_of_Processor_Chips
item:Quest65.description: Collect 3 of these, then hold down on the stack of 3 to unlock the Chip Repository!

item:Quest66.name: Strung_Jewels
item:Quest66.description: Collect 7 of these, then hold down on the stack of 7 to unlock the Jewel Spinner!

item:Quest67.name: Bottled_World_Town_Teleport
item:Quest67.description: Buy this once and hold down on it to permanently allow for free teleports inbetween World Towns without consuming a teleport! From town to town, free of charge!

item:Whetstone.name: Anvil_Reset_Whetstone
item:Whetstone.description: Hold down on this item to completely reset your spent Anvil Points for this character.

item:Quest68.name: Bucket_of_Slush
item:Quest68.description: Drop this on the snowy pile in the Refigeration Station in World 3. There are rumors that the recent snowfall will coagulate with the slush in horrible ways...

item:Quest69.name: Skull_(Dungeon)
item:Quest69.description: It may be a skull, but it sure ain't no Killroy!

item:Quest70.name: Phone_Box
item:Quest70.description: IdleOn is out on iOS devices! The Rift Ripper must have kept a few of these back when he played during the iOS Launch event... Hold down to open, and a random reward will drop at your feet!

item:Quest71.name: Gem_Envelope
item:Quest71.description: Contains a random number of gems, hold down to open! It could be just a couple gems, but it could also have as many as 10,000 gems!

item:Quest72.name: Bottled_Wind
item:Quest72.description: Hold down instantly gain 6 Hours of Sailing Progress!

item:Quest73.name: Gaming_Fertilizer
item:Quest73.description: Hold down instantly gain 8 Hours of Gaming Progress!

item:Quest74.name: Rift_Tear_(Dungeon)
item:Quest74.description: You shouldn't be reading this... unless it's like on the Wiki or something, then yea I ain't pointin' no fingers or nothing.

item:Quest75.name: Spring_Baggie
item:Quest75.description: Hold to open! Contains a random Spring Event goodie, from event cards to foods! ALSO, if you open a total of 500 Baggies, you'll get a limited edition Spring event NAMETAG!

item:Quest76.name: Silver_Pocketwatch
item:Quest76.description: Hold down to change your daily reset time by 15 minutes. If this item is on the left side of the inventory, your daily reset will be 15 minutes LATER. If it's on the right side, your daily reset will be 15 minutes EARLIER.

item:Quest77.name: Gold_Pocketwatch
item:Quest77.description: Hold down to fast forward a day, restocking shops and triggering various daily rewards and systems.

item:Quest78.name: Equinox_Mirror
item:Quest78.description: Hold down to enter the Equinox Valley map. You can later teleport there from the map once you unlock Dreams

item:Quest79.name: Falloween_Treat
item:Quest79.description: Hold to open! Contains a random Falloween Event goodie, including 3 limited time Monster Masks, check Patch Notes in Discord or Steam for info! Also, if you open 500 Treats you'll get the Falloween Event NAMETAG!

item:Quest80.name: Crop_Transfer_Ticket

item:Quest81.name: Compost_Bag

item:EquipmentStatues3.name: Mining_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues3.description: A stone statue that resembles some sort of double edged scythe. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats

item:EquipmentStatues4.name: Feasty_Statue

item:EquipmentStatues5.name: Health_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues5.description: A stone statue made by someone for a romantic propsal. I don't think it ended well. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats

item:EquipmentStatues6.name: Kachow_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues6.description: A stone statue named after the catch phrase of a very fast and very not real red car. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats

item:EquipmentStatues7.name: Lumberbob_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues7.description: A stone statue named in a world where the name Jack doesn't exist. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats

item:EquipmentStatues8.name: Thicc_Skin_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues8.description: I don't think the sculptor who named this statue back in 3000 BC would be happy with how his typo would be interpreted.

item:EquipmentStatues9.name: Oceanman_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues9.description: What's that, statue? You want to... take me by the hand and lead me to the land? With that land pecifically being the one that you understand?

item:EquipmentStatues10.name: Ol_Reliable_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues10.description: It takes a true artist to make a realistic statue like this one. He captured the flying aspect of those stone flies perfectly!

item:EquipmentStatues11.name: Exp_Book_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues11.description: I haven't read a book since middle school, so I'm just assuming this is what they look like.

item:EquipmentStatues12.name: Anvil_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues12.description: A little monument to the efforts of a most devious coyote, whose dreams were always just out of reach, and whose head often felt the crushing blow of defeat.

item:EquipmentStatues13.name: Cauldron_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues13.description: They used to tie women to these things and throw them into the ocean to see if they were a witch. If they were, they'd use all the water in the ocean to upgrade the cauldron and thus not drown! Not sure what happened if they werent.

item:EquipmentStatues14.name: Beholder_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues14.description: This statue is beautiful! Well, at least to me.

item:EquipmentStatues15.name: Bullseye_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues15.description: This statue was created by shooting a target statue into a stationary arrow statue.

item:EquipmentStatues16.name: Box_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues16.description: It's more of an open container than a box, really.

item:EquipmentStatues18.name: EhExPee_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues18.description: The sculptor got so fed up with people misinterpreting his previous statues, he felt the need to spell this one out.

item:EquipmentStatues19.name: Seesaw_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues19.description: The end result of someone trying to cut a slab in half with a ceramic saw, and then leaving early after they saw me watching them in the bushes, writing down what they were doing in this description.

item:EquipmentStatues20.name: Pecunia_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues20.description: This statue gonna make u heckin rich!

item:EquipmentStatues21.name: Mutton_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues21.description: This statue makes me really hungry... but for some reason it inspires me to cook rather than giving higher food bonuses.

item:EquipmentStatues22.name: Egg_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues22.description: This statue somehow boosts the effectiveness of Mobs getting it on...

item:EquipmentStatues23.name: Battleaxe_Statue

item:EquipmentStatues24.name: Spiral_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues24.description: This statue will bring you closer to god. Or gods in this case, the world of IdleOn is polytheistic!

item:EquipmentStatues26.name: Compost_Statue

item:EquipmentStatues27.name: Stealth_Statue

item:EquipmentStatues28.name: Essence_Statue

item:EquipmentStatues30.name: Dragon_Warrior_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues30.description: It somehow boosts the bonuses given by all other statues!!! You don't understand what that means? It's ok, I didn't get it the first time either...
