quest:Scripticus13.description: Reach Lv 8, then create a 2nd character! They gather resources WHILE you play on your 1st character!!

quest:Krunk1.name: A_Plot_to_be_Perfect
quest:Krunk1.description: Get Krunk some things that will probably not explode when mixed.

quest:Krunk3.name: King_of_the_Cavern
quest:Krunk3.description: Gather some construction materials for Hank... I mean Krunk.

quest:Glumlee2.name: Learning_to_Smelt
quest:Glumlee2.description: Smelt a Copper Bar at the Forge

quest:Glumlee3.name: Literally_Burning_your_Money
quest:Glumlee3.description: Go to the Forge, and buy 2 upgrades

quest:Glumlee4.name: The_Impossible_Task
quest:Glumlee4.description: Pick up the microphone. Good luck, you'll need it...

quest:Glumlee5.name: He's_Havin'_a_Bad_Day
quest:Glumlee5.description: Yea, he dropped it again... you know what to do.

quest:Picnic_Stowaway1.name: The_Hungry_Stowaway
quest:Picnic_Stowaway1.description: Craft the Orange Shirt at the Anvil, and bring it here unequipped. You can equip it after

quest:Picnic_Stowaway3.name: Live-Action_Entertainment
quest:Picnic_Stowaway3.description: Kill the mushrooms! If you fail, forfeit the quest using the Codex and retry!

quest:Picnic_Stowaway4.name: The_Most_Important_Meal_of_the_Day
quest:Picnic_Stowaway4.description: Get frog legs and bean slices

quest:Picnic_Stowaway7.name: Afternoon_Tea_in_a_Jiffy
quest:Picnic_Stowaway7.description: Get the tea back before it gets cold!

quest:Picnic_Stowaway8.name: Early_Evening_Eating_Endeavor
quest:Picnic_Stowaway8.description: Get baby here a little baby bowl because he can't eat kebabs like a big boy.

quest:Picnic_Stowaway9.name: The_Last_Supper,_at_Least_for_Today!
quest:Picnic_Stowaway9.description: Hope you read the previous dialogue!

quest:Picnic_Stowaway11.name: A_Midnight_Snack
quest:Picnic_Stowaway11.description: Get rare cookie drops from Twilight Desert mobs.

quest:Picnic_Stowaway12.name: King_of_Food
quest:Picnic_Stowaway12.description: Collect 30 Picnic tokens, and you'll get a trophy!

quest:Hamish1.name: The_Hamazing_Plot_Twist
quest:Hamish1.description: Find an axe to trade for the stamp!

quest:Hamish2.name: Should_We_Tell_Him?
quest:Hamish2.description: Use the recipe and craft the helmet.

quest:Hamish3.name: Slime_for_Storage
quest:Hamish3.description: Get them 50 slime sludge. They're like lv. 3, they'll accept.

quest:Mr_Pigibank1.name: A_Pig_and_his_Stamps
quest:Mr_Pigibank1.description: Buy a stamp from the town shop

quest:Promotheus3.name: Slovakian_Scare
quest:Promotheus3.description: Find the house monster in the Birch Grove.

quest:Promotheus4.name: The_Witcher,_but_not_Really
quest:Promotheus4.description: Me too, go kill it and see what loot you get!

quest:Cactolyte1.name: Super_Skillage
quest:Cactolyte1.description: Get the required skill levels in Mining, Smithing, and Choppin to impress Cactolyte club member!

quest:Cactolyte2.name: Top_Skillage
quest:Cactolyte2.description: Get the required skill levels in Fishing, Alchemy, and Catching to impress Cactolyte club member!

quest:Cactolyte3.name: Peanut_De-Aging
quest:Cactolyte3.description: Defeat Biggie Hours with this peanut in your inventory. Don't drop it, or it'll decay to dust in 5 seconds flat!

quest:Stiltzcho1.name: Outta_the_Way_Slimes
quest:Stiltzcho1.description: Kill 10 Slimes before time runs out

quest:Stiltzcho2.name: No_Stone_Unturned
quest:Stiltzcho2.description: Kill Baby Boa Snakes until you find remnanets of the gem thief. Baby Boas are on the next map.

quest:Stiltzcho3.name: Investigator_by_Day,_Prankster_by_Night
quest:Stiltzcho3.description: Gather carrots from the next map after this one, as well as some logs from the Beans map.

quest:Stiltzcho4.name: Time_Crime_Episode_1
quest:Stiltzcho4.description: Investigate Green Spores near town to see which one is stealing Stiltzcho's time.

quest:Stiltzcho5.name: Time_Crime_Episode_2
quest:Stiltzcho5.description: Investigate Frogs to see which one is has been hoppin' away with Stiltzcho's time!

quest:Stiltzcho6.name: Time_Crime_Season_Finale
quest:Stiltzcho6.description: Investigate Slimes to see which  of these slimeballs is the real thief of with Stiltzcho's time!!

quest:Funguy1.name: Mushroom_Munchies
quest:Funguy1.description: Get 15 Snake Skin, 5 Slime Sludge, and 5 Bean Slices!

quest:Funguy2.name: Videogame_Highscores_are_COOL!
quest:Funguy2.description: Get a score of 20 in the Choppin Minigame. Play it by going to any tree in the game, like the Oak Tree way back at the 1st map with the mushroom monsters!

quest:Funguy3.name: Partycrastination
quest:Funguy3.description: Collect clocks by defeating jungle monsters!

quest:Funguy5.name: Wicked_Party_Cleanup
quest:Funguy5.description: Get toilet paper to help clean.

quest:Tiki_Chief2.name: Three_Strikes,_you're_Out!
quest:Tiki_Chief2.description: Hand out flyers by dropping them on the right NPCs

quest:Tiki_Chief3.name: Blame_it_on_the_Glublins
quest:Tiki_Chief3.description: Clear out some Goblins, and totally invite everyone again!

quest:Tiki_Chief4.name: Hotel?_Tikivago._Sorry,_couldn't_Help_It!
quest:Tiki_Chief4.description: Defeat the boss 5 times, and 1 time in under 30 seconds.

quest:Dog_Bone1.name: Why_he_Die???
quest:Dog_Bone1.description: Defeat Wooden Boards below and collect 3 Bones, then return here!

quest:Dog_Bone2.name: Bow_Wow_going_Dow..n!
quest:Dog_Bone2.description: Bring back 25 amarok stones from defeating amarok.

quest:Builder_Bird1.name: Restoring_Power_to_the_Portal
quest:Builder_Bird1.description: Defeat the Boss at the end of World 1 to retrieve the gem and open the portal to WORLD 2!!

quest:Papua_Piggea3.name: Stamp_Collecting
quest:Papua_Piggea3.description: Bring more stamps, but not so many that the pig would have to pay Stampcome Tax

quest:Papua_Piggea4.name: This_Little_Piggy_Felt_Remorse
quest:Papua_Piggea4.description: Upgrade your stamps a bunch to cheer them up

quest:Desert_Davey2.name: U_Cool?
quest:Desert_Davey2.description: Bring cool proof. And dont worry, you'll get to keep the items!

quest:Mutton1.name: Beatboxing_Starterpack
quest:Mutton1.description: Find the right clothes for an aspiring fool who doesn't realize his beatboxing sucks.

quest:Mutton2.name: Clout_Chasin'
quest:Mutton2.description: Beat up the trashiest monsters until Mutt becomes famous

quest:Mutton3.name: Cross_Platform_Promotion
quest:Mutton3.description: Find some more followers, probably from the Sewers again since his beatboxing still sucks.

quest:Speccius1.name: More_like_'Sleepius'_lmao
quest:Speccius1.description: Bring 100 kebabs from the Town Shop, and 50 Crabby Cakey from defeating crabcakes.

quest:Fishpaste972.name: Can_you_do_the_Can_Can?
quest:Fishpaste972.description: Catch 3 Hermit Cans in a row, manually.

quest:Scubidew1.name: Don't_Step_to_Me,_Bro!
quest:Scubidew1.description: Show him there are no water monters.

quest:Scubidew2.name: Uncovering_the_Deep_Sea_State!!!
quest:Scubidew2.description: Catch 5 fish in 2 minutes, right here, right now.

quest:Scubidew3.name: A_Normal_Quest.
quest:Scubidew3.description: He's much better this way. I can't have too many free thinkers, not in this world, not in its current state. Get him a fish.

quest:Whattso2.name: The_Whaley_Hard_Minigame
quest:Whattso2.description: They look even sadder now, try doing something else...

quest:Whattso3.name: Bobbin'_Bobbers
quest:Whattso3.description: Thats a good face, I think! Do whatever you just did some more!

quest:Whattso4.name: The_Biggest_Fish_in_the_Sea...?
quest:Whattso4.description: The whale stares at you. He's too happy. You know what must be done.

quest:Postboy_Pablob1.name: Signed,_Sealed_and_Lost_in_the_Post
quest:Postboy_Pablob1.description: Craft 5 Empty Boxes from Anvil Tab 2

quest:Bandit_Bob1.name: Bullets_for_Bandit_Bob!
quest:Bandit_Bob1.description: Get ya boy Bob some bullets!

quest:Bandit_Bob2.name: Bob's_Brand_New_Bandana
quest:Bandit_Bob2.description: Get Bob a yellow bandana, even though it would ruin his style.

quest:Bandit_Bob3.name: Bringing_Bob's_Boxes
quest:Bandit_Bob3.description: Make some deliveries for Plan-It Experess over at the post office.

quest:Bandit_Bob4.name: The_Desert_Dungeon_Prequest
quest:Bandit_Bob4.description: Go get a Sesame Seed, a rare drop from actively fighting Mimics.

quest:Carpetiem1.name: Darn_Lazy_Gamers!
quest:Carpetiem1.description: Kill 750 Potatos. Idle kills don't count.

quest:Carpetiem3.name: Be_like_Buster!
quest:Carpetiem3.description: Defeat the former Heavyweight Champ with Red Boxing Gloves equipped.

quest:Carpetiem4.name: Helping_100_times_over
quest:Carpetiem4.description: Say 'The boomer aint so bad' to 30 different players.

quest:Djonnut1.name: Genie_Dieting
quest:Djonnut1.description: Gather 10 Shrapshell by defeating the Snelbies on this map!! Also bring some food from the Town Store!

quest:Djonnut2.name: I'm_Blue_Dabadedada
quest:Djonnut2.description: Defeat 4000 Moonmen and get one of their rare ghost drop! It's a 1 in 2000 chance per kill!

quest:Djonnut3.name: The_Blue_New_World
quest:Djonnut3.description: He's blue, get him blue stuff from world 3, nuff said.

quest:Goldric1.name: Trickle_Down_Economics
quest:Goldric1.description: Collect copper coins by running over them.

quest:Goldric2.name: Hoopsies
quest:Goldric2.description: Pass through 15 hoops in a row. @ OR @ Pass a total of 90 hoops across all attempts

quest:Goldric3.name: Only_Winners_have_Portraits
quest:Goldric3.description: Find various goldric paintings from Desert Monsters.

quest:Goldric4.name: Criminal_Code_of_Conduct
quest:Goldric4.description: Find the perfect gift for an animated gold bar monarch. You may have to sift through a lot of crap to find it!

quest:Goldric5.name: Dress_to_Impress
quest:Goldric5.description: Equip a golden helmet, platebody, platelegs, and any golden tool.

quest:Goldric6.name: Dont_lay_a_finger_on_my_Sheepies!!!
quest:Goldric6.description: Defeat all sandcastle monsters without hurting the sheepies.

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar1.name: Helping_Omar
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar1.description: Bring Omar some thread to help him fix his Anchor Rope.

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar2.name: Helping_Omar_Again
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar2.description: Bring Omar some time candy so he can get some fishing gains!

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar3.name: Helping_Omar_A_3rd_Time
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar3.description: Bring Omar some Sharks and a bobjoepickle so he can use them as bait to catch legendary fish on Saltwater Island!

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar4.name: Helping_Omar_Some_More
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar4.description: Bring Omar some Kraken and some bobjoepickles so he can use them as bait to catch more legendary fish on Saltwater Island!

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar5.name: Helping_Omar_Yet_Again_Deja_Vu
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar5.description: Bring Omar some new bait, I think he wants bugs...? Oh and some more bobjoepickles of course!

quest:Omar_Da_Ogar6.name: Helping_Omar_For_the_Final_Time
quest:Omar_Da_Ogar6.description: Bring Omar some of the legendary fish, turns out he couldn't actually catch any...

quest:Meel2.name: Waitin'_for_the_Cards_to_Drop
quest:Meel2.description: Collect Bonemeal for Meel! This will take a while...

quest:Snake_Jar1.name: Lookin'_Like_a_Snack
quest:Snake_Jar1.description: Get some teeth so you can be eaten! Mmm, yummy!

quest:Snake_Jar2.name: Red_Stuff_Bad!
quest:Snake_Jar2.description: BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GODS!!! Err... I mean, get HP pots!

quest:Snake_Jar3.name: PSA._You_Are_Being_Eaten!
quest:Snake_Jar3.description: Wait, why do they want to pretend to have eaten you again? Uh oh, I don't like the look of that Quest Helper...

quest:Snake_Jar4.name: A_Noob,_served_Medium_Rare!
quest:Snake_Jar4.description: Lure another player to Snakejar's platform, and have them say 'Hi'.

quest:Loominadi1.name: Rhyming_is_Key!
quest:Loominadi1.description: Kill moonmen until they drop all the keys you need.

quest:Loominadi2.name: Uh,_Something_About_Vials?
quest:Loominadi2.description: Upgrade 13 Vials up to light-blue rarity or higher

quest:Loominadi3.name: Journey_to_the_Center_of_the_Blundermines
quest:Loominadi3.description: Reach the Ol' Straightaway mining area, with Plat and Dementia ore.

quest:Loominadi4.name: The_Mummy_of_Mystery
quest:Loominadi4.description: Find the biggest secret in all of YumYum Desert, and defeat it.

quest:Wellington1.name: Platforms_in_Disguise,_Platsformers!
quest:Wellington1.description: Find the 3 invisible platforms hidden throughout the game.

quest:Wellington2.name: Findin'_Fingerprints
quest:Wellington2.description: Collect materials, maybe the blobulyte left some fingerprints on one?

quest:Wellington3.name: You_Can't_Run,_but_you_Can_Hide
quest:Wellington3.description: Give up on your search for the Maestro Blobulyte by saying 'Darn you, Blobulyte! Why must you hide like a coward'

quest:Dazey1.name: Dressing_like_a_Dork
quest:Dazey1.description: Help Dazey build a Sprout costume. You don't actually need a pea brain, that was just her being a jerk.

quest:Dazey2.name: Literally_Physics
quest:Dazey2.description: Get some woodular circles from branches, and do something with them? I don't go to Dazey's school either, I'm as confused as you are.

quest:Cowbo_Jones2.name: The_Hatless_Howerhouse!
quest:Cowbo_Jones2.description: Kill 20 Sandy Pots, without your precious hat equipped.

quest:Cowbo_Jones3.name: No_Country_for_One_Character
quest:Cowbo_Jones3.description: Create at least 3 new players for your Account.

quest:Cowbo_Jones4.name: Say_Goodbye_to_your_Dubloon!
quest:Cowbo_Jones4.description: Buy a Gold Dubloon to prove your worth.

quest:Cowbo_Jones6.name: Three_Vials?_Those_are_Rookie_Numbers!
quest:Cowbo_Jones6.description: Unlock 2 Vials. Stand infront of the Cauldron, then drag an item, like Copper, out of your inventory

quest:Cowbo_Jones9.name: A_Hat_in_Crime
quest:Cowbo_Jones9.description: Yes, Bandit Bob set you up, and yes, Cacto Jones does seem possessed by an evil power!

quest:Cowbo_Jones10.name: Commence_Criminal_Crimes!
quest:Cowbo_Jones10.description: Commit a crime on whoever the quest helper says to lol

quest:Cowbo_Jones11.name: The_Worst_Trade_Deal_in_History
quest:Cowbo_Jones11.description: Buy and sell a total of 10 Golden Dubloons.

quest:Cowbo_Jones12.name: Children?_What'd_they_ever_do_for_Me...
quest:Cowbo_Jones12.description: Donate to the Starving Orphan Monsters foundation in the Cauldron.

quest:Cowbo_Jones13.name: Oh_No,_not_the_Elderly!
quest:Cowbo_Jones13.description: Find some old coot to assist. Some old rag, a real carpet of a fella, you know what I mean.

quest:Cowbo_Jones14.name: Tomb_Raid
quest:Cowbo_Jones14.description: Raid Efaunt's tomb, defeat him, and steal his crystal.

quest:Typhoon1.name: Surprise_Attack!
quest:Typhoon1.description: Kill froggies. Forfeit the quest by clicking the Codex if you fail!

quest:Centurion1.name: Down_The_Mimic_Hole!
quest:Centurion1.description: Defeat all mimics before the time runs out.

quest:Centurion3.name: High_Scorer
quest:Centurion3.description: Get a 200K+ colosseum score. Remember to skip rounds to grow your score multiplier!

quest:Centurion4.name: Colosseum_Champ!
quest:Centurion4.description: Complete all 15 waves with a final score of 350K+

quest:Centurion5.name: Colosseum_GDQ
quest:Centurion5.description: Complete the three colosseums with lots of Time Remaining after beating all waves.

quest:Centurion6.name: Centurio_Rank
quest:Centurion6.description: Complete the Astro Colosseum within World 4

quest:Centurion7.name: Legatus_Rank
quest:Centurion7.description: Complete the Molten Colosseum within World 5

quest:Centurion8.name: Glorious_Gladiator
quest:Centurion8.description: Complete the Whimsical Colosseum within World 6

quest:XxX_Cattleprod_XxX1.name: Peak_Gaming
quest:XxX_Cattleprod_XxX1.description: Kill all the Mafioso's before they respawn.

quest:XxX_Cattleprod_XxX2.name: Wait_No,_I_meant_Pathetic_Gaming
quest:XxX_Cattleprod_XxX2.description: Defeat Mafiosos and Sand Castles super fast

quest:XxX_Cattleprod_XxX3.name: Ok,_NOW_it's_Peak_Gaming!
quest:XxX_Cattleprod_XxX3.description: Collect ratings from mobs and ask other players whose names start with P or S to say '1 star, game sucks!' to collect more ratings.

quest:Giftmas_Blobulyte1.name: Boo,_Headshot!
quest:Giftmas_Blobulyte1.description: Defeat Giftmas Ghosts, which have a rare chance to spawn from defeating normal monsters.

quest:Giftmas_Blobulyte2.name: You_Shouldn't_Have!_No,_really.
quest:Giftmas_Blobulyte2.description: Ah, they mean cash and jewelry! Go get a dubloon and some shiny glass from Sandy Pots, both from the Desert!

quest:Telescope1.name: I'm_Seeing_Stars!
quest:Telescope1.description: Follow the engraving's advice, and press the little constellation on the bottom right branch.

quest:Loveulyte1.name: Heart_Hogger
quest:Loveulyte1.description: Defeat monsters and collect their old Love Letters for this joy-hogging blobulyte.

quest:Loveulyte2.name: Heartbreaker
quest:Loveulyte2.description: Hold down on Love Letters and break some hearts!

quest:Egggulyte1.name: Egg_Shaped_Lootboxes!
quest:Egggulyte1.description: Defeat monsters and find some egg capsules! Open them for rewards!

quest:Egggulyte2.name: I've_Got_a_Golden_Tickegg!
quest:Egggulyte2.description: Open Egg Capsules until you find a Golden Egg! Previously found ones don't count!

quest:Iceland_Irwin1.name: Crikey,_it's_cold_out!
quest:Iceland_Irwin1.description: Go defeat Frost Flakes, past the Sheepies, and collect their cool shapes!

quest:Hoggindaz1.name: Turn_ON_for_what???
quest:Hoggindaz1.description: Turn on Redox Combustion in the refinery, and collect Mushroom Caps and Copper Ore until you have 24 hours of fuel.

quest:Hoggindaz2.name: Trapping_with_the_Lord
quest:Hoggindaz2.description: Go to the map to the left, and learn about the Trapping Skill.

quest:Hoggindaz3.name: Constructing_a_Tower
quest:Hoggindaz3.description: Build the Red and Orange Signposts, and also make some Cogs by going to the 'Cog' Tab and opening the Cog Shelf and dragging in some players.

quest:Hoggindaz4.name: Monke_Tower_Time!
quest:Hoggindaz4.description: Start a round of Tower Defence, by going to the Goblin Map in World 1. Also, equip that wax skull!

quest:Hoggindaz5.name: Taking_Samples
quest:Hoggindaz5.description: Use the Star Book, then add the talent to your attack bar and take samples!

quest:Hoggindaz8.name: Voter_Apathy
quest:Hoggindaz8.description: Get Bill Brr's Vote for Hoggi.

quest:Hoggindaz10.name: The_Fresh_Prince_of_the_Tundra
quest:Hoggindaz10.description: Prove your worthiness as the Tundra's Frost Prince.

quest:Bill_Brr1.name: Fairly_Odd_Damage
quest:Bill_Brr1.description: Deal an 'odd' amount of damage 8 times in a row.

quest:Bill_Brr2.name: Laughin'_Amphibian
quest:Bill_Brr2.description: Defeat the Giga Frog with Bill's joke in it.

quest:Bill_Brr3.name: The_Spores_are_a_Bore
quest:Bill_Brr3.description: Do the thingy for this annoying ham slice.

quest:Bill_Brr4.name: Coin_Shenanigans
quest:Bill_Brr4.description: Pick up the coin by running over it.

quest:Bill_Brr6.name: Duckin'_and_Shatterin'
quest:Bill_Brr6.description: Do what he just said, why do I have to say it over again?

quest:Bellows2.name: Eyexperience
quest:Bellows2.description: Get at least 3200 EXP from a single Neyeptune kill

quest:Bellows3.name: Veyebing
quest:Bellows3.description: Defeat a Giant Neyeptune monster. You must have Tachion of the Titan Prayer equipped to get Giant monsters to spawn.

quest:Bellows4.name: Optometric_Hoarder
quest:Bellows4.description: Have a bunch of lenses in your inventory at once. They wont take them, they just wants to see them.

quest:Crystalswine4.name: Melting_the_Snakes
quest:Crystalswine4.description: Defeat all the Cryosnakes in this map before time runs out

quest:Crystalswine5.name: Sunrunning_to_Chizoar
quest:Crystalswine5.description: Defeat every Cryosnake, Bop Box, and Neyeptune before time runs out.

quest:Crystalswine6.name: Global_Warming
quest:Crystalswine6.description: Defeat every monster inbetween here and Dedotated Rams.

quest:Yondergreen2.name: Economic_Policy
quest:Yondergreen2.description: Kill penguins until there are 75 coins on the ground, but there CANT be any other types of items on the ground

quest:Yondergreen3.name: Stance_on_Big_Tech
quest:Yondergreen3.description: Take a printer sample of at least 20 pens

quest:Yondergreen4.name: Legislative_Action
quest:Yondergreen4.description: Collect contracts. They only drop from penguins you kill actively, not while you're gone!

quest:Yondergreen5.name: No_Snapping_Contract
quest:Yondergreen5.description: Go idle at Stache map for exactly 4 hours 10 minutes. You can be off by only a few minutes.

quest:Yondergreen6.name: Keep_Away_Contract
quest:Yondergreen6.description: Go idle at Flakes map for exactly 9 hours 33 minutes. You can be off by only a few minutes.

quest:Yondergreen7.name: Ad_Solidarity_Contract
quest:Yondergreen7.description: Go idle at Bop Boxes map for exactly 21 hours 51 minutes. You can be off by only a few minutes.

quest:Worldo1.name: Odd_Jobs_for_Cold_Hard_Cash
quest:Worldo1.description: Complete 15 jobs in the Glacial Basement Dungeon. It's the task shown at the top.

quest:Worldo2.name: Can't_Guard_if_you're_Dead!
quest:Worldo2.description: Defeat 12 Ice Guards in a single run.

quest:Shuvelle1.name: Mayoral_Luck
quest:Shuvelle1.description: Kill Mamooths and get lucky with tusk drops. If you fail, you need to FORFEIT the quest in the codex.

quest:Shuvelle2.name: Mayoral_Skill
quest:Shuvelle2.description: Bring some Mosquisnow Bugs to Shuvelle.

quest:Shuvelle3.name: Mayoral_Sack_Size
quest:Shuvelle3.description: Have 8000 Mamooth tusks in your inventory at once. She won't take them from you, don't worry.

quest:Shuvelle4.name: Mayoral_Movie_Taste
quest:Shuvelle4.description: Get a DVD from mamooths, which is a super rare drop.

quest:Shuvelle5.name: Diggy_Hole!
quest:Shuvelle5.description: Kill mamooths and have shovels drop into the place right under the rope.

quest:Shuvelle6.name: Diggy_Diggy_Hole!
quest:Shuvelle6.description: Kill Snowman and have shovels drop into the place right above the Totem.

quest:Shuvelle7.name: Dig_Diggily_Diggy_Dig_Dig_Hole!
quest:Shuvelle7.description: Kill Thermisters, and have shovels drop into the place right near the, uh... hmm idk, but you'll figure it out!.

quest:Lonely_Hunter2.name: Skeleton?_Skelegone!
quest:Lonely_Hunter2.description: Summon Skeletons by breaking the skull rock in the top right of the colosseum, and destroy them!

quest:Lonely_Hunter3.name: Opening_Chests
quest:Lonely_Hunter3.description: Break open chests in this colosseum.

quest:Carpenter_Cardinal1.name: Restoring_Power,_once_again,_to_a_Portal
quest:Carpenter_Cardinal1.description: Retrieve the Galaxial Amethyst from Chizoar, the World 3 boss.

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt1.name: Pelt_for_the_Pelt_God
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt1.description: Collect material from Snelbie Snails, and Snakes. Also, buy a trap from the Town Shop.

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt2.name: Frogecoin_to_the_MOON!
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt2.description: Go trap Froge Critters, found in the SLIME map in Blunder Hills.

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt3.name: Yet_another_Cartoon_Reference
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt3.description: Go trap Crabbo Critters, found by the sea.

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt4.name: Small_Stingers,_Big_Owie
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt4.description: Go trap Scorpie Critters. No hint where they are, sorry... I'm still stuck on the Crabbo quest myself!

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt11.name: To_Trap_or_not_to_Trap
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt11.description: Catch a TON of Shinies... like, a TOOOOOON.

quest:Snouts1.name: A_Salty_Fall
quest:Snouts1.description: Get some Refinery Salts to make into a pile for Snouts to fall onto.

quest:Snouts2.name: Gravity_VS_Salt
quest:Snouts2.description: Get some Orange Refinery Salts, hopefully they wont react with the snow.

quest:Snouts3.name: Big_Ol_Chonker
quest:Snouts3.description: Defeat a giant monster. You need a Prayer for giants to spawn at all remember.

quest:Snouts4.name: Mana_Plox
quest:Snouts4.description: Get the big circular mana potions for Snouts!

quest:Coastiolyte1.name: Cooler_than_a_Cooler!
quest:Coastiolyte1.description: Crack open 15 Coolers with the lads!

quest:Coastiolyte2.name: Vibe_Check
quest:Coastiolyte2.description: Clear the beach of all these 'Out of Towner' monsters, namely 5 Plasti Dougs and 5 Mr Blueberry's

quest:Walupiggy1.name: Treasure_Hunt_1
quest:Walupiggy1.description: Complete the 1st Treasure Hunt! You need to go to the official IdleOn youtube channel to find the clues to follow to complete this!

quest:Walupiggy2.name: Treasure_Hunt_2
quest:Walupiggy2.description: Complete the 2nd Treasure Hunt! Clues are at the official IdleOn youtube channel remember!

quest:Walupiggy3.name: Treasure_Hunt_3
quest:Walupiggy3.description: Complete the 3rd Treasure Hunt! Clues are on the official IdleOn youtube channel!

quest:Walupiggy4.name: Treasure_Hunt_4
quest:Walupiggy4.description: Complete the 4th Treasure Hunt! Clues are on the Legends of Idleon youtube channel!

quest:Toadstall2.name: Bigger_Party_Better_Party!
quest:Toadstall2.description: Be in a party of 3. You can request to join someone elses party by doing what you do to invite while not being in a party yourself!

quest:Gangster_Gus2.name: Perfect_Progress_Score
quest:Gangster_Gus2.description: Defeat Snakenhotep, who will come out of hiding if you get 100% Progress.

quest:Gangster_Gus3.name: Sanke_Revival_Denial
quest:Gangster_Gus3.description: Defeat Enraged Snakenhotep. I'll give you a hint... those skull rocks must be destroyed at all costs!

quest:Falloween_Pumpkin1.name: The_Spookyness
quest:Falloween_Pumpkin1.description: Defeat monsters, AFK gains don't count.

quest:Falloween_Pumpkin2.name: The_Scaryness
quest:Falloween_Pumpkin2.description: Play a party dungeon with a party of 4 or more people.

quest:Falloween_Pumpkin3.name: The_Horroriness
quest:Falloween_Pumpkin3.description: Defeat monsters, AFK gains don't count.

quest:Falloween_Pumpkin4.name: The_Booeyness
quest:Falloween_Pumpkin4.description: Say 'boo' to 200 different people, without closing the Game. If you do, your counter will reset.

quest:Falloween_Pumpkin5.name: The_Afterparty
quest:Falloween_Pumpkin5.description: Defeat monsters with other party members around you.

quest:Oinkin1.name: Filling_the_Menu
quest:Oinkin1.description: Level up three meals to Lv.2 by delivering them to the Menu Dinner Table in town.

quest:Oinkin2.name: Diner_Deliverer
quest:Oinkin2.description: Upgrade various pet upgrades using Grey DNA and meals.

quest:Oinkin3.name: Recipe_for_Fattening_Pastry
quest:Oinkin3.description: Discover the recipe for Croissants in cooking.

quest:Gobo1.name: Breeding_in_Outer_Space
quest:Gobo1.description: Breed a green mushroom in the Egg Nest station.

quest:Gobo2.name: Intense_Mob_Fighting
quest:Gobo2.description: Back at the Egg Nest station, win the first battle in the grasslands.

quest:Gobo3.name: Squirrel_Tactics
quest:Gobo3.description: Unlock squirrel breeding by getting lucky while breeding the mushroom, and place it in your newly claimed territory. Wait a bit, then claim your spice!

quest:Gobo4.name: Spicy_Cooking
quest:Gobo4.description: At the kitchen, start cooking a new recipe using your spice. Use some of the Ladles Gobo gave you to finish it up instantly!

quest:Gobo5.name: Lab_Experimentation,_Ft._You
quest:Gobo5.description: Upload a few  of your characters to the Lab Mainframe. You'll need more than 1 player uploaded to reach the 1st bonus!

quest:Blobbo1.name: A_Honker_Took_mah_Baby!
quest:Blobbo1.description: My Blobinese is a bit rusty, but I think she's saying her children went running after some Honker Critters, and have been missing ever since. Maybe get some honkers and they'll come back?

quest:Blobbo2.name: Glitter_Critter
quest:Blobbo2.description: Ah I see, she actually said her children love shiny things, and chased after some shiny critters. Bring as many shiny critters as you can, I'm sure they'll come flopping back!

quest:Nebula_Neddy1.name: Task_Requirement_Affirmative
quest:Nebula_Neddy1.description: Gather some monster parts to show you're ready to take on the World 4 tasks!

quest:Eliteus1.name: The_Greenie_Gucci_Gang
quest:Eliteus1.description: Defeat all the Greenie Genies in the Greenie Gang.

quest:Masterius1.name: Mastering_the_Vibe_Check
quest:Masterius1.description: Prove yourself by following your inner voice.

quest:Slargon1.name: Shut_up_the_Namecallers!
quest:Slargon1.description: Beat up monsters to change public perception of Slargon.

quest:Slargon2.name: Smack_the_meanies!
quest:Slargon2.description: Beat up Maccies to further change public perception of Slargon.

quest:Slargon3.name: Mess_with_the_Misters!
quest:Slargon3.description: Beat up Mister Brightsides to uh, well, to make Slargon feel good I guess.

quest:Slargon4.name: Assert_Dominance_over_the_Meek!
quest:Slargon4.description: Complete the cycle. Destroy the meek.

quest:Pirate_Porkchop1.name: Bring_me_the_Booty
quest:Pirate_Porkchop1.description: Get Porkchop some gold bars. He wont take them, don't worry, he has no space in his boat.

quest:Pirate_Porkchop3.name: Seeking_Treasure_Shrooms
quest:Pirate_Porkchop3.description: Find Porkchop some rare multishroom treasure.

quest:Pirate_Porkchop4.name: Ye_finest_treasure_at_once!
quest:Pirate_Porkchop4.description: Find Porkchop the rarest treasure there is!

quest:Poigu1.name: Think_twice_speak_once
quest:Poigu1.description: I speak pretentious, and he's saying you need to level up divinity and show your faith.

quest:Poigu2.name: Speak_from_the_heart_not_the_mind
quest:Poigu2.description: Wow la de da ya friggin piglet. He's telling you to level up divinity more, but I'd totally understand if you just wanna stop talking to this guy.

quest:Poigu3.name: Learn_the_Language_of_the_Universe
quest:Poigu3.description: He's just being a pansy because his divinity is all he has... maybe if you outlevel him he'll stop being so annoying.

quest:Muhmuguh1.name: Wave_after_wave_slowly_Sailing
quest:Muhmuguh1.description: Do the sailing things that Muhmuguh says!

quest:Muhmuguh2.name: Rising_up_and_Growing_as_a_Gamer
quest:Muhmuguh2.description: Go to the Underground Computer and upgrade the Gaming Garden 3 times!

quest:Muhmuguh3.name: Learn_the_Language_of_the_Universe
quest:Muhmuguh3.description: Unlock the 1st divinity by meditating at the Divinity alter on characters you don't play!

quest:Lava_Larry1.name: W5_Task_Req_Check
quest:Lava_Larry1.description: Kills some mobs and gather monster parts to show you're ready for the World 5 tasks!

quest:Spirit_Sungmin1.name: Mind,_Body,_Soul,_Tasks
quest:Spirit_Sungmin1.description: Kills some mobs and gather monster parts to show you're ready for the World 6 tasks!

quest:Rift_Ripper1.name: Entering_The_Rift...
quest:Rift_Ripper1.description: Get these random items to gain access to The Rift.

quest:Nebulyte1.name: Species_Slayer
quest:Nebulyte1.description: Get 1M deathnote kills on all monsters in World 1, 2, and 3. Remember, Deathnote Kills are account-wide, this is NOT kills just on your Maestro.

quest:Nebulyte3.name: Oh_Geez_Lets_Not_Think_About_This_One...
quest:Nebulyte3.description: Defeat 12 million green mushrooms by yourself. Check Monster Card to see your personal killcount.

quest:Bubbulyte1.name: Spring_Splendor
quest:Bubbulyte1.description: Collect and open 500 baggies, dropped from killing any monster. You'll get a nametag on your 500th baggie!

quest:Tired_Mole1.name: Establishing_Order_among_Molekind
quest:Tired_Mole1.description: Defeat Biggole Moles to acquire Boss Keys. AFK kills count.

quest:Tired_Mole2.name: Like_taking_Keys_from_a_Crawler
quest:Tired_Mole2.description: Defeat Crawlers within the cave to get more Boss Keys. AFK kills count.

quest:Tired_Mole3.name: Divine_Endeavor
quest:Tired_Mole3.description: Get Kattlekruk to drop his cape on Nightmare to prove your capability at taking down the Divine Gods themselves.

quest:Monolith1.name: Surface_Level_Jealousy
quest:Monolith1.description: Prove you know the Statue Man by leveling up Statues to Lv 250 total and bringing 17 different statues

quest:Monolith2.name: Onyx_Statue_Crafting
quest:Monolith2.description: Bring some statues to the monolith, and youll get to make ONYX STATUES!

quest:Royal_Worm1.name: Let_the_Tails_Hit_the_Floor
quest:Royal_Worm1.description: Fill all 3 platforms with worm tails.

quest:Royal_Worm2.name: Bothering_Mutants
quest:Royal_Worm2.description: Spawn and defeat 5 Mutated Mush monsters by dropping toxic sludge oil on those spores near town...

quest:Royal_Worm3.name: Royal_Score
quest:Royal_Worm3.description: By arcade, he means colosseum... get a score of 48,500,000

quest:Royal_Worm4.name: Downfall_of_the_Hammer_Things
quest:Royal_Worm4.description: Defeat all Stilted Seekers before they respawn with Big Brain prayer on.

quest:Royal_Worm5.name: Kickin'_the_Can
quest:Royal_Worm5.description: Reach Wave 55 in Clash of Cans Tower Defence, and do a lot of personal damage by yourself.

quest:Royal_Worm6.name: A_Royal_Gift
quest:Royal_Worm6.description: Bring an entire 10,000,000 greenstack of Worm Tails

quest:Royal_Worm7.name: Bossin'_the_Boss
quest:Royal_Worm7.description: Defeat the Troll boss on Nightmare 100 times.

quest:Royal_Worm8.name: Normie_Bidding
quest:Royal_Worm8.description: Do all other Quests here in World 4.

quest:Lafu_Shi1.name: Seed_Planting
quest:Lafu_Shi1.description: Go to the compost bag, select a seed, then click the empty land plot.

quest:Lafu_Shi2.name: Visiting_the_Farmer's_Market
quest:Lafu_Shi2.description: Grow apples, pick apples, spend apples to buy more land!

quest:Lafu_Shi3.name: Climbing_the_Ninja_Hotel
quest:Lafu_Shi3.description: Embrace Sneaking culture, and Sneak your way up the hotel!

quest:Lafu_Shi4.name: Emporium_Investing
quest:Lafu_Shi4.description: Purchase something from the Jade Emporium. These bonuses are MAJOR big time awesome!!

quest:Lafu_Shi5.name: Summoning_Debut
quest:Lafu_Shi5.description: Win a Summoning Match. Your slime army should come out victorious if you place them correctly!

quest:Lafu_Shi6.name: Essence_Juicing
quest:Lafu_Shi6.description: Click the white Summoning Stone on the pillar and spend your essence.

quest:Hoov1.name: Sneak_Dropout
quest:Hoov1.description: Reach Lv 10 in your Sneaking Skill

quest:Hoov2.name: Stealth_Check_1_2_3
quest:Hoov2.description: Have a total Stealth of 10,420 on your Ninja Twin. Check Skill Info to see your ninja twin's Stealth amount.

quest:Hoov4.name: Sneak_Graduate
quest:Hoov4.description: He won't be right with you, he's obviously ducking. Just go reach Sneaking Lv 80, continue without him you already got his stamps lmao

quest:Woodlin_Elder1.name: Portal_Issues
quest:Woodlin_Elder1.description: Defeat 400,000 Woodlin Spirits to open the portal, business as usual, forget this Elder chump!

quest:Woodlin_Elder2.name: Big_Lock_Picking
quest:Woodlin_Elder2.description: Defeat 400,000 Woodlin Spirits on a 2nd character, that must be what the big lock is all about!

quest:Woodlin_Elder3.name: Fiddy
quest:Woodlin_Elder3.description: Defeat exactly 50 Woodlin Spirits. Stand on the top right platform to lock in your killcount. Killcount resets if incorrect.

quest:Woodlin_Elder4.name: Hunned_Fiddy
quest:Woodlin_Elder4.description: Defeat exactly 150 Woodlin Spirits. Stand on the top right platform to lock in your killcount. Killcount resets if incorrect.

quest:Woodlin_Elder5.name: Triple_Tre
quest:Woodlin_Elder5.description: Defeat exactly 333 Woodlin Spirits. Stand on the top right platform to lock in your killcount. Killcount resets if incorrect.

quest:Sussy_Gene1.name: Goofin'_Around
quest:Sussy_Gene1.description: Have a Summoning Match last 2 minutes or more, Spawn 5 bloomies in a single match, and Spawn 1000 slimes across all matches.

quest:Sussy_Gene2.name: Messin'_Around
quest:Sussy_Gene2.description: Have 2500 mana in a Summoning Match at once, get you and your opponent down to just 1 hp each, and spawn 8 Vrumbies from a single card.

quest:Sussy_Gene3.name: Loiterin'_Around
quest:Sussy_Gene3.description: Have a Regalis familiar in your sanctuary, play 7 special units in a row (non grey slimes), have a summoning match last 5 minutes or more.

quest:Potti1.name: First_Showdown...
quest:Potti1.description: Defeat The Emperor boss, found at the end of World 6

quest:Potti2.name: Castle_Cleanup
quest:Potti2.description: Make your way up to the Top Floor of the Ninja Castle

quest:Potti3.name: Glory_to_the_Crop_Depot
quest:Potti3.description: Collect 180 different Crops, shown by the Crop Scientist

quest:Potti4.name: Star_Master
quest:Potti4.description: Complete all 9 Constellations found in World 6 maps.

quest:Potti7.name: Spirit_of_the_Hero
quest:Potti7.description: Defeat The Emperor on 'Showdown L', which is the 50th showdown.

quest:Sad_Urie1.name: Urie_Wants_to_be_a_Millionaire
quest:Sad_Urie1.description: Bring a stack of 1 million of any golden food, and you'll unlock a new Beanstalk mechanic!

quest:Snootie1.name: Lost_Possum
quest:Snootie1.description: Find Pommsie in Pebble Cove, the 1st Spelunking Cave.

quest:Snootie2.name: Lost_Amber
quest:Snootie2.description: Find a blue amber, and pretend it's one of a kind and that you didn't find 100s of them

quest:Snootie3.name: Lost_Doll
quest:Snootie3.description: Find Mister Jazzie in Bizarro, the 7th Spelunking Cave

quest:Bloo_Radley1.name: To_Guide_a_Shypig
quest:Bloo_Radley1.description: Set a good example and reach the map above this one, I'm sure our friend Bloo will follow us!

quest:Bloo_Radley2.name: The_Hero's_Journey
quest:Bloo_Radley2.description: Clear the path for Bloo by defeating all the Demonblubs before any respawn, I'm sure he will make his way to the top!

quest:Toobus_Goobus1.name: TUNNEL_EXPLORING
quest:Toobus_Goobus1.description: Go visit the Spelunker Tunnel on the left side of town, and unlock the first lore bonus by defeating the boss on Depth 7

quest:Toobus_Goobus2.name: FEAR_HOLE!_FEAR_HOLE!
quest:Toobus_Goobus2.description: Go finish the Spelunker tutorial by AFKing in the Fearful Tunnel until you level up your Spelunking Skill!

quest:Toobus_Goobus3.name: READING_CHALLENGE
quest:Toobus_Goobus3.description: Collect 100 Pages from Spelunking, and hold down on them in your inventory to Level Up your Lore Chapter bonuses!

quest:Toobus_Goobus4.name: RESEARCH_STUDIES
quest:Toobus_Goobus4.description: Complete the 3 steps to learn Research! Full details are over at that desk near Spelunking caves, thats where lava designs his updates!

quest:Zenelith1.name: 1_Million_Statues
quest:Zenelith1.description: Bring 1,000,000 Power Statues, and youll get to make ZENITH STATUES!
